title: How to Get More Google Reviews Without Breaking the Rules
description: How to get more Google reviews: 6 rule-friendly ways to ask, reply and keep reviews flowing, plus what not to do so your reviews don't get removed.
h1_main: How to Get More Google Reviews
dek: Simple, rule-friendly ways to get more Google reviews, reply to them well, and avoid the mistakes that get reviews removed.
primary_keyword: how to get more google reviews

faq.q: Can I offer a discount in exchange for a Google review?
faq.a: No. Google doesn't allow incentives for reviews, including discounts, freebies and prize draws. You can ask, but you can't reward.

faq.q: Can I remove a bad Google review?
faq.a: Only if it breaks Google's policies, for example if it's spam, offensive or not about a real experience. You can flag it. Otherwise, the best response is a calm, helpful reply.

faq.q: Should I reply to every Google review?
faq.a: Yes. It shows you're paying attention, and a thoughtful reply to a negative review can win over future customers.
